entities.name: Procedure Initiation
entities.description: The UE initiates a procedure when certain conditions are met, specifically when the access attempt is considered as barred.

entities.name: Access Attempt Barred
entities.description: Condition where the UE's access attempt is considered as barred, triggering procedure initiation.

entities.name: RRCReject
entities.description: Message received by the UE that indicates rejection of RRC connection establishment or resume attempt.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE entity that performs the procedure initiation when conditions are met.

relations.description: Procedure initiation requires the condition that the access attempt is considered as barred.
The access barred condition is guarded by the reception of RRCReject message.
The UE initiates the procedure when triggered by the barred access condition and RRCReject reception.
